request: MAG-5 — New records improvements. Six gateway-side form/handler fixes for the manual charge 'Log a charge' page: (1) delete-row alert bug; (2) remove the vehicle field — sourced from the menu vehicle selector; (3) disable currency — always COP; (4) make start/end battery % required + suggest the latest telemetry battery % on the start field; (5) auto-fill today's date on optional started_at/ended_at and move them up from 'More details' to the main card; (6) allow 3 decimals on energy added, keeping the nearest-valid-range helper applied after 3 decimals. Single-module (internal/gateway), no DB object, no manualcharge/telemetry module change.

review.brief: Review commit c1a2bab (wave 1) for gateway-improve-manual-charge-form, MAG-5. Read the diff, not the whole module. Validate: (1) D1-D7 in design.md are each implemented as specified — flag any deviation, especially D2's suggestion rendered as an input placeholder rather than a helper label, and D5's new Disabled flag on ui.InputProps; (2) the D3 CSRF fix is genuinely fail-closed — checkCSRF/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare must not be weakened, and the hx-headers path must not open a bypass; (3) module boundary — no edits outside internal/gateway, other modules reached only via their public ports (telemetry.Reader, manualcharge.Reader/Writer), no internal/*/db import; (4) doc-pack conventions: ai/htmx-conventions.md and ai/htmx-go-integration.md for the markup and fragment wiring, ai/go-conventions.md incl. the km/percent unit-suffix rule, no business logic in templates (today's date is handler-computed); (5) Performance-Profile read-heavy — the added LatestSnapshotsByAccount call must be ONE read per page build, no per-row or per-request N+1, and graceful on error; (6) tests actually assert the new behavior (battery required + out-of-range, 3-decimal energy persisted, date defaults, suggestion present/absent, delete 200 + empty row, stale-CSRF 403 with no writer call) rather than restating it; (7) anti-gaming — no acceptance criterion in tasks.md was weakened, deleted, or self-approved, and every [x] matches real code. Known-open and NOT a finding: T7.4 (live browser smoke) is blocked pending the user. No DB object exists in this change; the database design gate does not apply. Escalate on doubt: return changes-requested for leader re-review rather than approving anything uncertain.

rounds.summary: D1-D7 all implemented as design.md authorizes, including the two flagged judgment calls (D2 placeholder, D5 Disabled-on-InputProps) which design.md/tasks.md explicitly permit. No task or acceptance criterion was reworded/weakened — tasks.md diff shows only checkbox flips. Independently re-ran go build/vet/test + make ui-guard, all green. decisions.decision: Move the optional started_at/ended_at fields out of 'More details' up into the main 'Log a charge' section; auto-fill today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) as default; keep both optional.
decisions.why: The MAG-5 author leaned this way ('I think worth moving up'); user confirmed. Improves discoverability of optional timing fields.

decisions.decision: Suggest the active vehicle's latest telemetry snapshot battery % as the start_battery_pct default (helper label), via the existing telemetry.Reader.LatestSnapshotsByAccount port; render no suggestion when no snapshot exists.
decisions.why: Multiple plausible sources existed (latest telemetry, last entry's end_battery_pct, both); user chose latest telemetry for fidelity to 'current battery percentage'. Reuses an existing port — no telemetry-module change.

decisions.decision: Treat the delete-row alert (T1) as a gateway-scoped root-cause task (reproduce-then-fix) rather than prescribing a fix up front; if the root cause turns out to be a manualcharge Writer/service bug, mark T1 blocked and re-dispatch as a separate manualcharge-* change.
decisions.why: The alert has three plausible gateway root causes (stale CSRF → 403, target/swap mismatch, Writer-error → ChargeRowError 500); fixing blind would bake in a guess. The boundary 'no manualcharge change' holds only if the bug is gateway-side.

decisions.decision: Run the dev-harness pipeline under opencode in degraded budget mode (budget: null, checkpoints warn-only) but with real kkpa-module-worker / kkpa-module-reviewer subagent dispatch via the Task tool.
decisions.why: opencode exposes the module-scoped worker/reviewer agent types, so roles are real subagents (not serial hats). The statusline budget cache is a Codex payload and is foreign under opencode, so per-task budget and auto-checkpoint degrade to warn-only — the pipeline never blocks on budget unavailability.

Delta restructured onto the real requirement headers, and the now-false 'Vehicle Auto-Select on the Charge Create Form' requirement REMOVED.

Unfixed the change cannot archive; forced through with --skip-specs the main spec would keep asserting a vehicle picker the code no longer renders.

decisions.why: A change must leave the main spec true. Archiving with these intact would have left three assertions describing a picker D4 deleted — exactly the rot that makes the spec untrustworthy as an agent's context.

decisions.decision: LEADER ERROR, recorded for audit: rolling back the test archive with 'git checkout -- openspec/' also destroyed the worker's uncommitted delta rewrite and this file's D9/blocked-event entries. decisions.why: The rollback was scoped to a directory rather than to the specific files the archive touched, and the worker's output in that same directory had never been committed. Lesson for future waves: commit or stash worker output before running a reversible experiment over the same path.
